title: kbmon's sprint panel lists done and long-gone items as landings in progress
goal: the sprint panel lists as in progress only a landing of an item still open in the backlog whose newest land.step has no later land.end, committed rows of one millisecond kept in their write order

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
E=dict(os.environ,CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=tempfile.mkdtemp(),CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=os.getcwd())
d=json.loads(s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py','--json','--panel','sprint'],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=120).stdout)
L=d['panels']['sprint']['data'].get('landings',[])
def gone(i):
    f='kb/_self/backlog/%s.json'%i
    return not os.path.exists(f) or json.load(open(f)).get('status') in ('done','dropped')
bad=[x['item'] for x in L if gone(x['item'])];print(len(L),'landings,',len(bad),'done or gone');sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

notes: SP-v4yih547 review: committed ops rows sort by (ts,id), so a land.step verify sharing a millisecond with land.end sorts after it and the landing stays open (6 done items); about 1,436 old rows with no land.end name no backlog item. The review changed ST-n5d72sm3 g2 to this fix.
